                           configures all three; not a fourth data layer

+--------------------------+        +--------------------------+        +--------------------------+
| CORPUS                   |        | EVIDENCE                 |        | REPRESENTATION           |
| authoritative, addressable|       | labels, summaries,       |        | revisioned visual        |

[Semantic contract / Corpus,        [Semantic contract / Evidence,      [Semantic contract / Representation,
 lines 31-38; H0 / Required           lines 40-50; H0 / Required          lines 52-61; H0 / Required
 composition, lines 168-176]          composition, lines 168-179]         composition, lines 168-180]

                                  CORE INTERACTIONS

CORPUS -------- Corpus -> Evidence: Collect and Validate -------------------------------> EVIDENCE
              exact anchor validation + source snapshot

EVIDENCE ------ Evidence -> Corpus: Resolve Anchors -----------------------------------> CORPUS
              validated anchors resolve to authoritative ranges and source reads

EVIDENCE ------ Evidence -> Representation: Generate and Ground -----------------------> REPRESENTATION
              finalized evidence selection + mapped spans + valid source ranges

REPRESENTATION  Representation -> Evidence: Mapped Reveal -----------------------------> EVIDENCE
              visual mapping resolves to Evidence before source reveal

REPRESENTATION  Representation -> Representation: Refine Revision ---------------------> REPRESENTATION
              refine, expand, derive, or edit without replacing evidence grounding

[Core invariants, lines 63-78; H0 / Required core interactions, lines 174-183]

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Evidence-Only Grounding Bridge                                                                      |
|                                                                                                    |
|   REQUIRED SOURCE REVEAL:  REPRESENTATION ------> EVIDENCE ------> CORPUS                           |
|   FORBIDDEN GROUNDING:     REPRESENTATION - - - - - - - - - - -> CORPUS                            |
